releaseNotes:
• Post Creation Decoupling: Fully generalized post & event creation flows across pan-India universities without hardcoded institutions
• Signup College Selector: Searchable M3 Expressive university picker directly on the authentication and onboarding screens
• Dynamic Feed Scope: Automatically replaces legacy campus tags with your university shortcode (e.g. My Campus (IITB))
• Material 3 Expressive Extended FAB: Brand new 56dp squircle Post Signal button with anchored tonal action cards and fluid spring motion
